description:
Create a folder in the workspace, optionally inside another folder, to organize projects.

Returns { folder_id, name, parent_folder_id, already_existed }. If a folder with the same name (case-insensitive) already exists in that parent, it is returned with already_existed=true instead of creating a duplicate — so it is safe to call to "ensure" a folder exists.

Put projects in it with create_project(folder_id=...) or update_project(project_id, folder_id=...). List existing folders with find(type='folders').

parent_folder_id.description: Create the folder inside this folder (use find(type='folders') for IDs). Omit for the workspace root.

name: create_folder
title: Create folder
